text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap asked me to come along to a 
shrine, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No matter what I do, I keep making small 
mistakes. I'm just completely out of it...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Masa-san said, 'When in trouble, 
pray to the gods.'"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Actually, after praying at the shrine 
inside my hometown racetrack, I even won a 
race once.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So, I decided to turn to God for help.
choice_data_list: Let's pray to the gods together!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Are you sure...? Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I made an offering, so hopefully my wish 
will be answered, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
……Hm? There is something inside my 
pocket……

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“—Th-This is a free noodle refill coupon 
for the ramen shop! Talk about immediate 
divine favor!”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure he means for me to eat some ramen 
and cheer up...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I feel like my body's lighter too... yeah. 
Guess I'll go eat some ramen...!

Afterward, with the blessings we received 
in hand, I went to eat ramen with Oguri 
Cap, who walked with a light, bouncy 
spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
How careless of me, letting that precious 
extra serving of noodles go to waste... 
*sigh*

At this rate, things aren't looking very 
auspicious...
